column1: # Sequence generation and train/held-out split config — the ClinVar sets of Table 2 of the manuscript.
# Each row defines one output dataset.
# Columns:
#   name             — output filename stem (used for data/sequences/ and data/splits/)
#   class0_files     — semicolon-separated BED paths assigned label=0 (benign)
#   class1_files     — semicolon-separated BED paths assigned label=1 (pathogenic)
#   unlabeled_files  — semicolon-separated BED paths with no label column
#   split            — yes: generate train/held-out splits in data/splits/
#                      no:  generate sequences only in data/sequences/
#   heldout          — held-out chromosome set of the split (split_data_fixed_chroms.py):
#                      architecture = chr 7, 8, 11, 15, 20; glm_missense = chr 2, 3, 16, 17
#   sizes            — comma-separated sequence window sizes to generate for this row (6k, 12k, 30k, ...)
# Leave class0_files and class1_files empty for unlabeled datasets.
# Leave unlabeled_files empty for labeled datasets.
# Lines starting with # are ignored.
# Split output filename format: {name minus mapping}.seq{size}.{mapping}_{training|validation}.tsv
# NOTE: File must end with a blank line or the last dataset row will be silently skipped.
# BvsP     = B vs P (strict mapping).
# BLBvsPLP = B + LB + B/LB vs P + LP + P/LP (expanded mapping).
# Rows (Table 2):
#   1. Architecture exploration: earlier release, strict, held out chr 7, 8, 11, 15, 20;
#      6k (NT-1, matched NT-2), 12k (NT-2), 30k (Caduceus-PS)
#   2. GLM-Missense training: earlier release, expanded, held out chr 2, 3, 16, 17; 12k
#   3. Later release: variants new in 260923, expanded, held out (test) chr 2, 3, 16, 17; 12k
# name
ClinVar.251103.missense.hg38.BvsP
ClinVar.251103.missense.hg38.BLBvsPLP
